kill_fact: The event itself survives every attack I could run against a primary source - it is genuinely live, un-fired and un-priced. What does not survive is the floor, which is the whole reason this is sized as a bounded-loss binary. Both the $3.20 'net cash per share' and the $2.00 failure floor deduct only the $0.634M debt line and silently ignore $33.367M of other current liabilities sitting on the same 31 March 2026 balance sheet - accounts payable $9.446M plus accrued expenses and other current liabilities $23.287M, of which $20.004M is accrued R&D, manufacturing and clinical expense (10-Q filed 12 May 2026, verified line by line). Net of ALL liabilities the balance sheet is $222.6M on 80,027,099 shares, or $2.78 a share today, not $3.20. Roll that forward on the actual cash-flow-statement burn of $46.4M a quarter and a Q3/Q4 readout leaves roughly $165-175M of cash against roughly $30M of payables still outstanding on the day the news lands - about $1.70 a share of distributable value BEFORE the 0.7-0.9x busted-shell discount the dossier itself insists on applying. Apply that discount and the honest floor is roughly $1.50 to $1.70, call it $1.60, not $2.00. The dossier corrected the board's $2.50 floor down to $2.00 for exactly this class of omission - two quarters of burn - and then made the same category of error itself one layer down. That is 8 percentage points of additional drawdown on a $4.82 stock: -67% to the floor rather than -58%. Second, the win case is computed on gross economics Atea does not own: Note 11 of the same 10-Q discloses tiered royalties to Merck of 'high single digits to mid-teens percentages' of annual net sales of any ruzasvir-containing product, plus a $10.0M milestone on FDA acceptance of the NDA - and the $6.90/share programme leg, derived from '$400 to $600 million of peak sales at 1.5 to 2 times peak sales', never deducts either. The asymmetry still clears zero (probability-weighted fair value falls to roughly $5.90, about +23% against $4.82), so this is a numbers kill, not a thesis kill. But both load-bearing dollar anchors move against the buyer, and they move in the same direction.
corrections:
1) FLOOR OVERSTATED - MATERIAL, and it is the load-bearing number in the file. sop_bear, consensus_delta, risk_reward, moderator_conclusion and interrogator_dossier section 5 all state net cash of '$3.20 a share' and a failure floor of '$2.00'. Verified from the 10-Q filed 12 May 2026: cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities $256,006K; total current liabilities $33,367K (accounts payable $9,446K; accrued expenses and other current liabilities $23,287K, of which R&D/manufacturing/clinical accruals are $20,004K); total non-current liabilities nil; 80,027,099 shares. Net of all liabilities = $222,639K = $2.78/share, not $3.20. Carried to a Q3/Q4 readout at the true operating burn: cash roughly $165-175M less roughly $30M of payables outstanding on the day = roughly $1.70/share of distributable value, then 0.7-0.9x for the busted-shell discount the file itself applies = $1.20-1.55, and the Evercore-mandate/activist-register argument justifies the top of that band at best. downside_floor should move 2.00 -> 1.60. Consequence: drawdown to the floor is about -67%, not -58%; risk_reward is roughly 1.25:1 on the extremes, not 1.5:1.

2) WIN CASE COMPUTED ON GROSS ECONOMICS - MATERIAL. 10-Q Note 11, Merck License Agreement (MSD International GmbH, December 2021): 'the Company will pay Merck tiered royalties based on annual net sales of Products ranging from high single digits to mid-teens percentages'; the next milestone, $10,000K, 'is payable upon the acceptance by the FDA of a NDA covering a product candidate including ruzasvir', anticipated in the quarter ending 30 June 2027. sop_bull's standalone leg ('peak sales of $400 to $600 million ... at the 1.5 to 2 times peak-sales multiple') deducts neither, and sop_breakdown never mentions the royalty. Up to roughly a sixth of the revenue stream underwriting the $6.90/share programme value belongs to Merck. Either net the royalty or state explicitly that the multiple is already royalty-adjusted. Related: the file's only reference to the licence is in the FAILURE branch ('a Merck licence Atea can terminate on ninety days' notice, so no trapped obligation') - correct there, and exactly backwards as grounds to ignore it in the win branch, which is the only branch where the licence costs money. The 10-Q says terminable 'for convenience upon prior written notice' with no period stated; the 'ninety days' figure is not sourced to the 10-Q.

3) CATALYST HARDNESS MISLABELLED - MATERIAL. catalyst_status is PENDING_HARD. There is no regulator-set, contractual or exchange-set date anywhere in this situation - no PDUFA, no outside date, no deadline. The only company date is self-set guidance ('remain on track for mid-year 2026', 25 June 2026) and that window lapsed roughly four weeks ago with no update. The only third-party-maintained date is the registry's estimated primary completion of September 2026, and the sponsor has not revised that record since 5 December 2025 despite seven months and an enrolment-completion announcement in between - so it stands as the sponsor's own uncorrected estimate rather than a mere artefact. The file discloses the lapse honestly in four places, so this is a labelling error, not a concealment: PENDING_HARD -> PENDING_SOFT. Cost of a one-quarter slip is not free at roughly $15M/month of burn: about $0.19/share off the floor per month.

4) ENTRY-PRICE FRAMING ONE-SIDED - MATERIAL, and it cuts FOR the bull. risk_reward and moderator_conclusion rest the entire '1.5:1 rather than 3:1' conclusion on 'the stock is already up about 73% from its 52-week low of $2.78.' Neither states that the 52-week HIGH is $6.45 and that $4.82 is 25% BELOW it. Measured from the high the stock has round-tripped, not run into the readout; the from-low-only framing overstates how much of the event is priced in. (Same from-LOW proximity trap logged in the 2026-07-24 apex cohort work.) Correcting it partially offsets corrections 1 and 2 - which is why the asymmetry survives at all.

5) DILUTION LEG CONTRADICTS THE ISSUER WITHOUT SAYING SO - MINOR-TO-MATERIAL. valley_of_death and interrogator_dossier section 6 assert as fact that 'Atea cannot fund a March 2027 filing, a commercial build-out and the continuing trials from $256 million.' The 10-Q states the opposite: existing resources 'will allow us to advance our current and planned clinical programs to and through key inflection points, prepare and submit an application for marketing approval of the regimen of bemnifosbuvir and ruzasvir, engage in pre-launch activities including the manufacture ... in commercial quantities sufficient to meet our initial sales projections and advance to late-stage clinical development of AT-587,' with runway 'through at least twelve months.' The arithmetic case for a raise is real ($46.4M/quarter against $256.0M is roughly 5.5 quarters), but present it as a disagreement with management, not as settled fact. Separately, the ATM is not merely 'a loaded lever' - the 10-Q confirms the shares are offered under a shelf on Form S-3 already 'declared effective', so an overnight offering is executable within hours of a positive topline.

6) BURN FIGURE - MINOR. '$45.8 million in the first quarter of 2026' is the decline in the cash-plus-marketable-securities balance ($301,830K to $256,006K). The cash-flow-statement figure is net cash used in operating activities of $46,391K. Use $46.4M in the roll-forward; it lowers the floor slightly further.

7) 'TOTAL DEBT $0.6 MILLION' MISCHARACTERISED - MINOR, and it cuts for the bull. The $634K line is the current portion of operating lease liabilities, not borrowings. Atea has no debt at all and no lender ahead of shareholders. The relevant claim on the cash is trade and accrual payables (correction 1), not debt.

8) WITHHOLD-VOTE COMPARISON - MINOR. positioning_washout says the shareholder-installed director 'drew barely a tenth as much dissent'. Per the 8-K filed 22 June 2026 (Item 5.07, meeting 18 June 2026), Berman's withhold was 6,607,050 against Adams's 22,275,665 - about 30%, not a tenth. The 43% headline is exact: 22,275,665 of 51,073,677 votes cast on that item = 43.6%.

VERIFIED UNCHANGED (attacked and survived): the catalyst is genuinely un-fired as of 28 July 2026 - the company's own 25 June 2026 release reaffirms C-BEYOND topline 'on track for mid-year 2026', the only release since (14 July 2026) is the unrelated AT-587 hepatitis E Phase 1 start and does not mention C-BEYOND, no 8-K has been filed since 22 June 2026, and NCT06868264 carries no posted results. Enrolment completion is 22 December 2025 (>880 treatment-naive patients, ~120 US/Canada sites) - the file's 'December 2025' is right. Registry staleness is real and correctly disclosed. There is no going-concern qualification, no debt maturity, no covenant, no financing contingency attached to the event, no CVR, no second-request-style process and no deal terms to trade through. The ATM is confirmed entirely undrawn: 'As of March 31, 2026, no shares have been issued under the Sales Agreement.' Q1 2026 R&D $41,134K and G&A $6,874K tie exactly to the file. The buyback claim is corroborated by the share count falling 85.2M (Q1 2025) to 78.1M (Q4 2025).
